records.issue_text: app/assets/stylesheets/common/components/badges.css.scss:239 — Darkening notification badge backgrounds while retaining $secondary text reduces black-theme 11px counter contrast to approximately 2.46:1, making counts difficult to read.
records.rationale: The diff at line 239 shows: `background-color: dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 70%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%));` and at line 240: `&[href] { color: $secondary; }`. In dark themes where $secondary is typically dark/black, the background becomes `scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 30%)` (a darkened secondary), while the text remains `$secondary`. This creates a low contrast situation where dark text appears on a dark background.
